title: Australia Postage Stamp 1d Queen Elizabeth Green
descriptionText: The Australia Postage Stamp 1d Queen Elizabeth Green is a used postage stamp from Australia featuring Queen Elizabeth on a green background. This ungraded stamp is a piece of Australian postal history depicting the royalty theme. Made in Australia, it is uncertified and a collectible item for stamp enthusiasts interested in Australian and royal memorabilia.
